title: Microsoft 365 Administrator
summary: A Microsoft 365 administrator runs a company's email, Teams, SharePoint and user identities in the Microsoft cloud. You usually sit in the IT infrastructure or messaging team, handle user and licence changes, keep mail and sign-in secure, and fix issues the service desk passes on.
dailyDuties: Create and change users, licences, mailboxes and groups
Fix mail flow, Teams and OneDrive issues raised by the service desk
Manage MFA and conditional access policies in Entra ID
Set up SharePoint sites and fix permission requests
Run PowerShell scripts for bulk changes and usage reports
Review security alerts and message trace results
Document changes and follow the change process

skills.expectation: Run Exchange Online, Teams and OneDrive: mailboxes, licences, policies and mail flow
Manage Entra ID users, groups, MFA and conditional access
Look after on-premises Active Directory synced to the cloud
Manage SharePoint Online sites, permissions and storage
Do bulk changes and reports with Exchange and Graph PowerShell
Work tickets and changes through ITIL processes
Explain changes and fixes clearly to users and support teams
Enrol devices and set compliance policies in Intune
Move mailboxes and files from on-premises or another tenant
Set up Teams calling and phone numbers
Manage Defender for Office 365 and endpoint protection settings
Build simple flows to automate admin requests
Apply retention, DLP and eDiscovery rules in Microsoft Purview

certifications.why: Covers Entra ID identity and access administration
Entry-level view of Microsoft security, compliance and identity
Useful when the role also covers Azure resources
Covers the device management side of Microsoft 365 administration.
For admins who also own Teams Phone.
Covers Purview labelling, DLP and retention, which M365 admins often run.
